answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 8360 Country: Canada Title: Is it permissible to wear a tie? Is it permissible to tuck one's shirt into one's trousers? Question: Is it permissible to wear a tie? Is it permissible to tuck one's shirt into one's trousers? Answer ID: 8360 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1282/1096=L/1429) (1) It is not allowed. (2) By tucking shirt into trouser, the parts of the body which should not be displayed are more revealed. Therefore it will be makrooh (undesirable). However, pant and shirt is the clothing of those involved in sin and obscenity; therefore Muslims should avoid wearing pant and shirt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
